cases.key: Array#[] on bare Array from Array.new(dynamic_size, fill)
cases.mechanism: Array.new with a Dynamic size discards the fill/block element type and yields unparameterized Array (literal size folds to a tuple) — verified by scratch bisect.
cases.fix_direction: Degrade to Array[type(fill)] / Array[type(block)] when size is Dynamic instead of bare Array.

cases.key: rest-parameter methods never fold their return (AverageMedian#average_median etc.)
cases.mechanism: Any user method with a *rest param answers Dynamic at all call sites even when every branch returns nil; the no-splat twin (incl. def-level rescue + raise) folds to nil — verified by scratch bisect M1-M6.
cases.fix_direction: Bind rest param as Array[join(extra args)] (or Array[untyped]) and continue body return folding.

cases.mechanism: inferred_return_untyped family (1055 cause sites): resolved user methods whose returns are param/ivar-sourced.
Minitest::Test ancestry has no RBS in the environment; assertions are unresolved implicit-self calls.
Same setter-RHS mechanism verified on textbringer: x[k]=v evaluates to RHS but is typed by dispatch.
cases.fix_direction: Type attribute-write CallNodes as their RHS.

cases.key: optional receivers from nil-unions (String?#split via gets, 0?#- via ivar nil-union)
cases.mechanism: Dispatch on T? answers Dynamic instead of the non-nil arm's result; beginner scripts hit it via gets and via ivar summaries that union nil.
cases.fix_direction: Type T? dispatch results via the non-nil arm; nil-arm stays diagnostic.

cases.mechanism: Bundled rbs core declares ::Thread::SizedQueue but not the toplevel ::SizedQueue/::Queue aliases; Rigor stub-synthesizes the constant and dispatch answers top.
cases.fix_direction: Builtin-import/overlay declaring the toplevel Queue/SizedQueue aliases.

cases.mechanism: Element reads of containers whose element type is opaque from A roots.
Only 1 site is a truly unhandled node class (CallOperatorWriteNode); the rest are unresolved implicit-self dispatch mislabeled unsupported_syntax — same taxonomy artifact as textbringer.
cases.fix_direction: Split the cause label; resolve via minitest RBS + toplevel def resolution.

cases.mechanism: attr_reader calls resolve through the discovered-method tier to Dynamic[Top]; needs ivar-field to accessor-return propagation.
